english_draft:
Samsung Electronics published its third quarter 2026 results on October 29, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue of KRW 195.3 trillion. This was a 14% increase quarter over quarter. This was another all-time quarterly revenue high. Operating profit was KRW 107.4 trillion. This was the first time a technology company exceeded KRW 100 trillion in quarterly operating profit.

The Device Solutions Division reported revenue of KRW 147.1 trillion and operating profit of KRW 106.5 trillion. DS Division sales increased 15% quarter over quarter. The Memory Business reported an all-time high in quarterly revenue and operating profit. Memory demand remained strong for AI applications. The company scaled up HBM4 sales and server SSD sales.

The Device eXperience Division reported revenue growth of 8% quarter over quarter. It recorded an operating loss of KRW 0.8 trillion. MX and Networks Businesses reported combined revenue of KRW 37.7 trillion and an operating loss of KRW 0.6 trillion. VD, DA, and Harman reported combined revenue of KRW 13.9 trillion and an operating loss of KRW 0.2 trillion. Samsung Display reported revenue of KRW 8.0 trillion and operating profit of KRW 1.1 trillion.

The company declared a quarterly cash dividend of KRW 4,601 per common share and per preferred share. Total dividend was KRW 30 trillion. For 2026, total shareholder returns were estimated at KRW 90 to 110 trillion. The company planned or completed KRW 35 trillion. The remaining amount was estimated at KRW 55 to 75 trillion. This amount includes share repurchases and cancellation and cash dividends.

Q3 capital expenditure was KRW 29 trillion. This was an increase of KRW 12.2 trillion quarter over quarter and KRW 19.8 trillion year over year. Nine-month capital expenditure was KRW 56.9 trillion. Full-year 2026 capital expenditure was expected at approximately KRW 84.4 trillion.

Company outlook for Q4 2026: Memory expects AI infrastructure investment to continue. Foundry expects double-digit revenue growth. MX expects year-end peak season sales growth centered on flagship models.
reader_questions: 新闻稿中的DS收入147.1万亿韩元是否为对外部客户的净收入？官方分部收入加总（206.7万亿韩元）高于合并收入（195.3万亿韩元），若差额来自内部抵销，在将DS收入与合并收入并置时应如何调整口径？
合并营业利润107.4万亿韩元与四个披露分部营业利润加总（约106.8万亿韩元）存在约0.6万亿韩元差异；官方未解释差额来源，这是否意味着还有未分配损益或内部抵销未被计入分部？
Harman的利润改善包含一次性美国关税返还，若剔除该非经常性项目，Harman乃至合并营业利润的可持续性是否仍支持“AI与存储驱动”的结论？

fact_checks.statement: 合并收入195.3万亿韩元，环比增长14%，再创单季历史新高。
fact_checks.verification: 官方新闻稿第一段明确写出。

fact_checks.statement: 合并营业利润107.4万亿韩元，为全球首家单季营业利润超过100万亿韩元的科技公司。
DS分部收入147.1万亿韩元、营业利润106.5万亿韩元，销售环比增长15%；存储业务收入和营业利润创季度新高。
fact_checks.verification: 官方新闻稿DS部分明确写出。

fact_checks.verification: 官方新闻稿各分部段落分别明确写出。
